verdict.rationale: stagewise documents user-initiated agent sessions: parallel agent instances, multi-step workflows, and a setting to keep the app awake while agents work. Nothing in the pack shows configurable automations that run on a recurring schedule or event trigger in the background without a user prompting each run. These are adjacent agent features (one-off, chat-driven actions), not background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
